tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The page: wool in light, fjord navy in dark. Carries the canvas weave.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Oat panels: the hero, crates, the photo pocket, the after-you-pay band. Navy text only (9.4:1 light; wool 10.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Lists, the fine-print strip and other reading surfaces that sit on a panel.

tokens.name: tag-paper
tokens.usage: Shipping tags and luggage tags: always light, in both themes.

tokens.name: on-tag
tokens.usage: Text and eyelet rings on tags, which stay light in both themes. 11.9:1 on wool, 9.4:1 on oat.

tokens.name: strap
tokens.usage: The header and footer straps.

tokens.name: on-strap
tokens.usage: Text and the lockup on a strap. 11.9:1 light, 14.1:1 dark.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text, stencils, rules and outlines. 11.9:1 on ground, 9.4:1 on panel (light); 11.9:1 / 10.2:1 (dark).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text. 6.3:1 on ground, 5.0:1 on panel (light); 8.0:1 / 6.8:1 (dark).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Tobacco: dashed list rules and dotted planned outlines. 5.1:1 on panel light, 3.7:1 on panel dark.

tokens.name: weave
tokens.usage: The canvas weave lines on the page ground (tobacco 6% / wool 3.5%). Decorative.

tokens.name: stitch-soft
tokens.usage: The hero's inset stitch. Decorative, 3.0:1.

tokens.name: stitch-tag
tokens.usage: The inner stitch on shipping tags. Decorative.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Every button's fill. The action colour is the ink colour; the splash marks which one.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Button text. 11.9:1 both themes.

tokens.name: splash
tokens.usage: Salmon. One object per page: one crate or one checklist row, never a band, hero, strap or ground. Also the 5px inset underline on buttons and one ski in the mark. Never text on light grounds (2.2:1).

tokens.name: on-splash
tokens.usage: Text on a salmon fill. 5.4:1.

tokens.name: on-splash-action
tokens.usage: Text on the navy button inside the salmon crate, both themes. 11.9:1.

tokens.name: splash-deep
tokens.usage: The slats on a salmon crate. Nothing else; never text.

tokens.name: splash-ink
tokens.usage: Salmon as text, when it must be text: 5.1:1 on wool (never on oat, 4.1:1), 5.4:1 on navy.

tokens.name: done
tokens.usage: Moss: finished lessons, owned modules, confirmed payments. With on-done text 6.4:1 light, 6.2:1 dark.

tokens.name: on-done
tokens.usage: Text on a done fill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form errors and failed payments, with a word and an icon. 5.6:1 on wool, 7.0:1 on navy. Never on oat.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 3px solid, 3px offset. Tags and the current checklist row reset it to on-tag / on-splash; straps to on-strap; the salmon crate to on-splash.

families.stencil: "Big Shoulders Stencil Display", "Arial Narrow", Impact, sans-serif
families.label: "Big Shoulders Text", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif

styles.name: stencil-xl
styles.usage: Page titles. Uppercase. One per page. Fluid: clamp(56px, 11vw, 168px).

styles.name: stencil-l
styles.usage: Section heads, on a 4px ink rule. Uppercase. Fluid: clamp(36px, 5.6vw, 72px).

styles.name: price
styles.usage: The price on a crate. Numbers only. Fluid: clamp(84px, 9vw, 128px).

styles.name: crate-title
styles.usage: Crate and card titles. Uppercase. Fluid: clamp(26px, 2.4vw, 32px).

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: The kicker block above a page title, ink fill with ground text.

styles.name: pull
styles.sample: LEARNING A NEW TECHNIQUE AS AN ADULT IS HUMBLING.
styles.usage: One pull quote per page. Uppercase, under a 4px rule. Fluid: clamp(24px, 2.6vw, 32px).

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Cross-country ski lessons for adult skiers, with 31 filmed demos and drills.
styles.usage: The sentence under a page title. Max 38 characters per line. Fluid: clamp(18px, 1.7vw, 21px).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every technique lesson covers body position and timing.
styles.usage: Running text. Max 58 characters per line.

styles.name: reading
styles.sample: Learning a new technique as an adult is humbling.

styles.name: fine
styles.sample: One payment each. Full refund within 14 days if it isn't for you.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Optical gaps only.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tag padding, small gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside the lockup; the inset of a stitch inside its panel.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Minimum side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Crate grid gap; padding inside a crate.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap under a section head.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Top of a section on phones.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top of a section and hero padding on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: crates, buttons, panels, lists, the hero. Canvas and timber have square corners.

tokens.name: radius-mark
tokens.usage: The mark's tile corner, at a 300-unit tile (9.3%). Only the mark.

tokens.name: stroke-weave
tokens.usage: Dashed tobacco list rules.

tokens.name: stroke-stitch
tokens.usage: Dashed stitching inside a panel, list outlines, empty photo slots, checkbox outlines.

tokens.name: stroke-button
tokens.usage: Button borders; the focus ring.

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: The ink rule under a section head and above a pull quote.

tokens.name: stroke-underline
tokens.usage: The salmon inset underline on buttons.

tokens.name: stroke-band
tokens.usage: The ink edge between full-width bands.
